sql: WITH family_listings AS (SELECT family, count(*) AS listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing GROUP BY family), total_listings AS (SELECT sum(listings) AS total FROM family_listings) SELECT f.family, f.listings, (f.listings * 1.0 / t.total) AS share_of_total, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY f.listings DESC) AS rnk FROM family_listings f, total_listings t ORDER BY rnk
